title: imagespec payload
description: A list of elements rendered in order. Numeric and boolean keys also accept the string forms Home Assistant templates produce at render time; this schema describes the authored types.

element.description: Any element placed by its own coordinates (top level or inside `group`).

stack_child.description: Any element inside a stack/row/column, which positions it (`x`/`y` optional).

pie.description: Pie or donut chart. Segment colours cycle through the device palette unless given.
